Accused in Minor's Rape-Murder Injured During Alleged Escape Attempt

An individual accused in the rape and murder of a minor girl sustained bullet injuries during an alleged escape attempt, according to police. This incident follows a separate case where a man was sentenced to 20 years of rigorous imprisonment for raping a minor. The reports highlight ongoing legal proceedings and police actions related to crimes against minors.
